headlines.title: 美财长贝森特称 霍尔木兹海峡将逐步失去战略重要性
headlines.summary: 美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特日前在接受美国亚利桑那州地方电视台采访时说，随着地缘政治局势变化，今后越来越多能源运输将绕过霍尔木兹海峡。他认为，霍尔木兹海峡将逐步失去战略重要性。鉴于伊朗试图控制这条咽喉要道，海峡将无法回到过去的状态。在接下来两年时间里，海峡将变成一片普通水域，逐步变得不再那么重要。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: US Treasury Secretary Bessent says Strait of Hormuz will gradually lose strategic importance
headlines.summary_en: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said in a recent interview with a local Arizona TV station that as geopolitical conditions evolve, an increasing amount of energy transport will bypass the Strait of Hormuz in the future. He believes the Strait of Hormuz will gradually lose its strategic importance. Given Iran's attempts to control this key waterway, the strait will not return to its past state. Over the next two years, the strait will become an ordinary body of water and gradually diminish in significance. (Xinhua)

headlines.title: 经济学家：通胀已是关乎美联储信誉的问题
headlines.summary: 阿波罗全球管理公司首席经济学家托尔斯滕·斯洛克表示：“目前通胀已经不限于经济问题，而是关乎美联储的信誉。自2021年以来，通胀一直高于目标水平。对于世界头号央行而言，高通胀持续的时间非常、非常久。”

headlines.title_en: Economists: Inflation is now a credibility issue for the Fed
headlines.summary_en: Torsten Slok, chief economist at Apollo Global Management, said: "Inflation is no longer just an economic issue—it's about the Fed's credibility. Since 2021, inflation has been above target. For the world's leading central bank, that's a very, very long time for high inflation to persist."

headlines.title_en: Commercial conversion accelerates! Over half of transacted residential land parcels in Shanghai and Shenzhen came from re-zoned properties
headlines.summary_en: [Commercial-to-residential conversion accelerating! Over half of transacted residential land parcels in Shanghai and Shenzhen 'changed identity'] With office vacancy rates climbing and residential properties in core areas in short supply, with new construction land facing the constraint of 'not being used for commercial real estate development in principle,' and with local land fiscal revenues under pressure, how can growth be found within existing stock? Since 2026, core cities including Shanghai, Shenzhen, Guangzhou, and Beijing have given the same answer—land use reclassification. Plots once designated for office buildings and factories are now being converted into residential land entering the land market.

headlines.title_en: Greenwoods Asset Management significantly trims holdings in popular tech stocks in Q2
headlines.summary_en: On August 7 local time, prominent 100-billion-yuan private fund Greenwood Asset disclosed its latest US equity holdings (13F) for the end of Q2 2026. In Q2, Greenwood cleared out popular tech stocks including Nvidia and Meta, and significantly trimmed positions in Intel, NetEase, and Google. Greenwood's US equity holdings market value fell sharply from $3.88 billion to $2.19 billion at end-Q2, a decline of 43%. While sharply reducing many existing positions, Greenwood also built stakes in select semiconductor supply-chain companies, including US optical module maker AAOI (Applied Optoelectronics), which recently beat earnings expectations. (China Securities Journal)

headlines.title: 生物制造驶入发展快车道 产业资本密集布局
headlines.summary: 近期生物制造赛道产业与资本动作密集。多家初创企业相继完成新一轮融资，华润双鹤、鲁抗医药等上市公司持续加大布局力度，产业落地节奏显著提速。业内人士认为，生物制造行业正处于从技术创新向产业应用加速转化的关键期。在技术突破、政策支持和资本涌入的多重驱动下，行业有望在未来5—10年实现规模化发展，成为全球制造业绿色转型的重要引擎。中国凭借完备的发酵产业基础和持续的政策支持，有望在全球生物制造竞争中占据重要地位。 (中证报)

headlines.title_en: Biomanufacturing enters fast-track development, with industrial capital deploying densely
headlines.summary_en: Recently, the biomanufacturing sector has seen intensive industry and capital activity. Several startups have completed new financing rounds, while listed companies such as China Resources Double Crane and Lukang Pharmaceutical continue to step up their investments, with industrial deployment accelerating notably. Industry insiders believe biomanufacturing is in a critical period of accelerating transformation from technological innovation to industrial application. Driven by technological breakthroughs, policy support, and capital inflows, the industry is expected to achieve scaled development in the next 5-10 years, becoming an important engine for green transformation of global manufacturing. Leveraging its complete fermentation industry base and sustained policy support, China is well-positioned to occupy an important place in global biomanufacturing competition. (China Securities Journal)

headlines.title: 中国稀土：2026年半年度净利润同比增长46.53%
headlines.summary: 8月7日，中国稀土发布2026年半年度报告，实现营业收入16.47亿元，同比下降12.19%；归属于上市公司股东的净利润2.37亿元，同比增长46.53%。报告期内，稀土行业供需格局持续调整优化，受稀土产业政策、下游市场需求提振等多重有利因素影响，市场行情整体上行，镨钕产品价格较去年同期涨幅明显。（新京报）

headlines.title_en: China Rare Earth: 2026 interim net profit up 46.53% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: On August 7, China Rare Earth released its 2026 semi-annual report, posting operating revenue of 1.647 billion yuan, down 12.19% year-on-year; net profit attributable to shareholders stood at 237 million yuan, up 46.53% year-on-year. During the reporting period, supply-demand dynamics in the rare earth industry continued to adjust and optimize. Supported by multiple favorable factors including rare earth industrial policies and downstream market demand, the overall market trend moved upward, with praseodymium-neodymium product prices rising notably versus the same period last year. (Beijing News)

headlines.title: 贷款利率定价基准“换锚” 利率市场化再进一步
headlines.summary: 近期，多家商业银行落地以DR（存款类金融机构间债券回购利率）为定价基准的企业贷款，标志着我国贷款利率定价基准多元化的探索提速。专家表示，持续丰富贷款定价参考基准，构建多元化基准利率体系，既是稳步推进利率市场化改革的重要举措，也有助于提升货币政策传导效能，更好地服务实体经济各类经营主体。 (中证报)

headlines.summary_en: Recently, several commercial banks have issued corporate loans priced on DR (deposit institution bond repurchase rate), marking accelerated exploration of diversified loan pricing benchmarks in China. Experts say that continuously enriching loan pricing reference benchmarks and building a diversified benchmark rate system is both an important step in steadily advancing interest rate marketization reform and helps improve the effectiveness of monetary policy transmission, better serving diverse entities in the real economy. (China Securities Journal)

headlines.title_en: U.S. 2-year Treasury yield falls 5 bps on payrolls day, down ~9.6 bps for the week
headlines.summary_en: At the New York close on Friday (August 7), the US 10-year benchmark Treasury yield fell 3.24 basis points to 4.6454%. When the US nonfarm payroll report was released at 20:30 Beijing time, it plunged from 4.6678%, hitting a session low of 4.6007% at 20:47. It fell 8.93% for the week, with August 4 seeing a notable decline. The 2-year Treasury yield dropped 5.02 basis points to 4.1952%, plunging from 4.2306% when the payroll report was released, and hitting a session low of 4.1515% at 20:40. It was down 9.59 basis points for the week.

headlines.summary: 近日，上海国投先导公示对上海智微凌峰创业投资合伙企业（有限合伙）的投资。该基金由智微资本担任管理人，目标规模30亿元。LP阵容汇聚中微公司、澜起科技等半导体龙头的旗下平台，工业X射线检测领域企业日联科技的子公司，以及地方国资平台，形成“产业资本+国有资本”的深度联合。智微凌峰基金以半导体设备、零部件、材料及先进封装等集成电路核心环节为主攻方向，重点挖掘“卡脖子”领域的“隐形冠军”。

headlines.title_en: Shanghai Guotou Leading participates in investment in Zhiwei Lingfeng Fund
headlines.summary_en: Recently, Shanghai Guotou Pilot disclosed its investment in Shanghai Zhiwei Lingfeng Venture Capital Partnership (Limited Partnership). The fund, managed by Zhiwei Capital, has a target size of 3 billion yuan. Its LP lineup brings together platforms under semiconductor leaders including AMEC and Montage Technology, a subsidiary of industrial X-ray inspection firm Nuctech, as well as local state-owned capital platforms, forming a deep alliance of 'industrial capital + state capital.' Zhiwei Lingfeng Fund focuses on core integrated circuit segments such as semiconductor equipment, components, materials, and advanced packaging, with an emphasis on uncovering 'hidden champions' in 'bottleneck' areas.

headlines.title: 德意志银行：预计美国7月CPI环比上涨0.15%
headlines.summary: 下周最重要的数据发布将是周三公布的美国7月CPI报告，随后周四将公布PPI数据。德意志银行美国经济学家预计，整体消费者价格环比上涨0.15%，6月为下降0.42%；核心CPI预计环比上涨0.26%，与6月持平。对于PPI数据，预计整体PPI环比上涨0.22%（此前为0.13%）。

headlines.title_en: Deutsche Bank: Expects US July CPI to rise 0.15% month-on-month
headlines.summary_en: The most important data release next week will be Wednesday's US July CPI report, followed by PPI data on Thursday. Deutsche Bank US economists expect overall consumer prices to rise 0.15% month-on-month, versus a 0.42% decline in June; core CPI is expected to rise 0.26% month-on-month, flat versus June. For PPI, they expect overall PPI to rise 0.22% month-on-month (prior: 0.13%).

headlines.title: 下半年楼市结构性行情预计强化 差异化产品成房企竞争关键
headlines.summary: 【下半年楼市结构性行情预计强化 差异化产品成房企竞争关键】房地产市场研究和数据分析机构普睿数智董事长丁祖昱7日在上海表示，上半年房地产市场延续结构性分化特征，行业并非简单进入总量恢复阶段，而是进入结构优化阶段，即核心城市、核心板块率先释放市场韧性，企业竞争逻辑正从规模扩张转向能力竞争。

headlines.title_en: Structural housing market trends expected to strengthen in H2; differentiated products key to developer competition
headlines.summary_en: [Structural trends in the housing market expected to strengthen in H2; differentiated products become key to developer competition] Ding Zuyu, chairman of real estate research and data analytics firm Pre-AI Data, said in Shanghai on the 7th that the property market continued to show structural divergence in H1. The industry is not simply entering a phase of aggregate recovery but a phase of structural optimization—core cities and core districts are the first to show market resilience, and corporate competition logic is shifting from scale expansion to capability competition.

headlines.title: 香港保监局：密切关注内地有关金融产品税务安排
headlines.summary: 近期报道称中国内地税务居民购买香港保险的收益被纳入征税范围。对此，香港保险监管局回应称，政府和保监局正密切注意内地有关金融产品税务安排的最新发展，同时会与业界保持紧密沟通。中国居民就境外投资收益必须依法申报及缴税的要求一直存在，市场不用过度解读或作出揣测。香港保险市场发展成熟，产品设计灵活先进，可提供货币选择、环球资产配置、人生规划、财富传承等专业服务，相信对内地客户有一定吸引力。

headlines.title_en: Hong Kong Insurance Authority: Closely monitoring tax arrangements for financial products in mainland China
headlines.summary_en: Recent reports say that investment income from Hong Kong insurance policies purchased by mainland Chinese tax residents has been included in the taxable scope. In response, the Hong Kong Insurance Authority said the government and the authority are closely monitoring the latest developments in tax arrangements for mainland financial products and will maintain close communication with the industry. The requirement that Chinese residents must declare and pay taxes on overseas investment income has long existed, and the market need not over-interpret or speculate. The Hong Kong insurance market is mature, with flexible and advanced product design offering currency options, global asset allocation, life planning, wealth succession, and other professional services, which are expected to remain attractive to mainland clients.

headlines.title: 禁止“抱团”抬价！东北明确新能源集中报价仅限同省同集团
headlines.summary: 据中国电力报，国家能源局东北监管局日前印发《东北区域集中式新能源发电企业集中报价工作实施方案（试行）》，对辽宁、吉林、黑龙江三省集中式风电、光伏发电企业的市场报价行为作出系统性规范。其中明确，原则上仅允许同一集团（同一母公司、同一控股股东、同一实际控制人等）内同一省的新能源发电企业进行集中报价，禁止跨集团、跨省集中报价。禁止具有竞争关系的经营者达成固定或变更商品关系的垄断协议。

headlines.title_en: Ban on 'grouped' price hikes! Northeast China clarifies centralized new-energy quotes limited to same province and same group
headlines.summary_en: According to China Electric Power News, the Northeast Regulatory Bureau of the National Energy Administration recently issued the 'Implementation Plan for Centralized Quoting by Concentrated New Energy Power Generation Enterprises in the Northeast Region (Trial),' systematically regulating market quoting behavior for concentrated wind and solar power generators in Liaoning, Jilin, and Heilongjiang provinces. It specifies that, in principle, only new energy power generation enterprises within the same group (same parent company, same controlling shareholder, same actual controller, etc.) in the same province are allowed to conduct centralized quoting, with cross-group and cross-province centralized quoting prohibited. Operators with competitive relationships are prohibited from reaching monopoly agreements that fix or change commodity relationships.
